arms: To evaluate the safety and feasibility of allogeneic Vγ9Vδ2 T cell therapy.

coder_notes: Early Phase 1 (translational subset); cell therapy only, so excluded at S6. Ages include CHILD (age >= 4). Temozolomide/radiotherapy may optionally be combined at week 4 in some patients; not a registered intervention and not given to every patient, so not listed. Registered 'arms' are objective statements, all receiving the same cell therapy; 'RANDOMIZED' allocation appears inconsistent with single-arm description. Treatment setting coded recurrent from 'ineffective conventional treatment' wording; could be argued unclear.
